authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: Make a photographic portrait of a woman, preserving the supplied reference's visible facial appearance and short dark bob with fine bangs. Present a distinct surreal photographic concept: an impossible spatial relationship is physically visible in an otherwise ordinary scene. In a nearly empty late-evening laundromat, the woman has just opened a front-loading washing machine and pauses beside it. The machine aperture opens into a full-depth blue-hour sea: a low ocean horizon and a pale distant sky recede far beyond the rubber drum gasket, while one small wave reaches the near inner lip. The round glass door is swung outward on its hinge and remains visibly separate from this deep opening. The floor, the machines beside it, and a half-filled laundry basket remain everyday, tangible objects. She stands at the left of the washer with her torso turned slightly toward the opening. Her nearer hand rests lightly on the outer door rim, fingers naturally separated around the metal edge; her other arm hangs by her side. Her shoulders have stopped mid-routine, her lips gently parted, and her eyes look into the impossible depth. She wears a simple pale blue cotton shirt with loose sleeves and dark straight trousers. Frame her from the upper thighs upward in a horizontal composition, with her face on the left and the large unobstructed washer opening on the right; show the whole hinge and swung-open door within the frame. The aperture occupies about a quarter of the image width. Photograph from a natural standing three-quarter position with a normal lens, keeping her face, fingertips, gasket, and the near wave clearly readable together. Soft overhead laundromat light makes the skin and cotton tactile; the cooler light from the sea opening falls across her nearer cheek and hand. Let the quiet pause and the single impossible connection carry the photograph, with a restrained palette of warm cream, brushed steel, pale blue and the deep blue sea.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image. After retrieval, retain candidate-informed changes only when needed for faithful meaning, legibility or consistency; do not expand the scene merely to use material.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction. After retrieval, consider local additions, replacements or subtractions with a concrete expressive benefit, keeping the overall direction close to the request.
